dispute_ticket.description: The driver cancelled on me and I got charged S$5.00. I came out to Lorong Liput as soon as I got the notification and the car was pulling away. I would like the fee refunded.

chat_logs.content: Arrived at Holland V MRT, silver Vezel next to the bus stop.
Outgoing call to rider - not answered (rang 20s, no response).
No reply, I have to go. Cancelling now.
Trip cancelled by driver. Reason: rider_no_show. Cancellation fee of $5.00 applied.
I am here at the road! Please come back

app_events.details: Rider R-2287 booked trip RYDE-CS-002 from Holland Village MRT (Lorong Liput) to Dempsey Hill. Pickup 12:00.
Driver D-6402 (Tan Boon Keat, Honda Vezel (SLE 9031 T)) assigned.
Driver tapped 'I'm Here'. Arrival recorded for the pickup point.
Push notification + in-app alert sent to rider: 'Your driver has arrived.'
Wait timer started at driver arrival. 3 min free wait period ends at 12:01.
Free 3-min wait period expired. Rider had not boarded.
Driver initiated in-app call to rider. Call rang 20s, no answer.
Cancel pressed by driver D-6402. Reason selected: rider_no_show.
Cancellation fee S$5.00 charged to rider payment method (credit_card).
Driver D-6402 released from trip. Trip status: cancelled (rider_no_show).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It covers rider cancellations and rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: Driver arrival is recorded at 11:58:00 and the driver cancelled at 12:04:00, a wait of 6 minutes. This trip's no-show threshold is 8 minutes, so the rider did not yet count as a no-show (short by 2 minutes). Cancelling before the threshold does not trigger the fee, so the S$5.00 charge is refunded to the rider.
